{{Quote|As with all our cakes, this old-fashioned favorite from Kowak is made from scratch using only the finest ingredients. The delectable cribblycrunch topping is sure to please even the most discriminating monkey-lizard.|The menu of Dex's Diner|<ref name="Hyperspace" />}}
'''Kowakian crumb cake''' was a type of [[Cake/Legends|cake]] that originated on<ref name="Hyperspace" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Kowak/Legends|Kowak]]. It had a [[cribblycrunch]] topping and was cylindrical in shape, with a dollop of [[Color/Legends|white]] icing on each piece.<ref name="Hyperspace" /> At some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] known as [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] sold the crumb cake for 2.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per slice. The menu of the diner described the Kowakian crumb cake as an old-fashioned favorite that was made from scratch using only the finest ingredients. It also claimed that the cake's cribblycrunch topping could satisfy [[Kowakian monkey-lizard/Legends|Kowakian monkey-lizards]],<ref name="Hyperspace" /> who were [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to Kowak.<ref name="NEGAS" />

A platter of the cake was on a counter in the diner when [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] visited the restaurant shortly before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outbreak]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="22 BBY">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], which include the appearance of Kowakian crumb [[Cake/Legends|cake]], to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Kowakian crumb cake was created for the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="Episode II" /> released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Movie date">{{ThisWeek|u0Z7i0LnXOg|Mandalorian Season 2 Directors, We Celebrate a Birthday, and More!|sw_url=video/mandalorian-season-2-directors-we-celebrate-a-birthday-and-more}}</ref> It was first pictured in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]'',<ref name="1stp">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> published on [[April 23]], 2002.<ref name="VD Date">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/ref/news20020227.html|text=Book Preview: DK Episode II Books}}</ref> The cake was then identified in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] and formatted as an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="Hyperspace" />
